supersedes_for_the_calibration_step: the pair-level copula arm of V64_NIH_CARD_REALISM_CALIBRATED_SYNTHETIC_DESIGN_CONTRACT_V1 and its executor successor rule
does_not_supersede: the parent design contract's allowed/forbidden inputs, firewall, nuisance families, frozen estimator, out-of-span rule, outcome classes, no-improvisation rule, seeds or M_MIN

WHY_A_SUCCESSOR_IS_NEEDED.finding: The calibration arms frozen so far operate on a FLAT, PAIR-LEVEL feature matrix. Both the Gaussian copula and the Iman-Conover reordering permute each feature column independently across rows. Whatever promoter hierarchy existed in the real matrix is destroyed by that permutation.
WHY_A_SUCCESSOR_IS_NEEDED.why_retrofitting_promoter_ids_does_not_f: Attaching promoter labels to the shuffled rows and grouping by them would assemble blocks whose feature values no longer belong together. That MANUFACTURES a hierarchy rather than restoring one, and the resulting promoter blocks would be internally incoherent -- a promoter's degree paired with another promoter's activity and a third promoter's edges.
WHY_A_SUCCESSOR_IS_NEEDED.why_it_matters_scientifically: Promoter degree and promoter activity are properties OF A PROMOTER, shared by all of that promoter's edges. Distance, accessibility, RE density and anchor frequency vary EDGE BY EDGE within a promoter. Collapsing that two-level structure into one flat table and then shuffling it destroys exactly the dependence that the nuisance families NEG_ANCHOR_1 and NEG_GEO_1 are designed to exploit, and that the estimator's cross-fitting BY PROMOTER is designed to handle.
WHY_A_SUCCESSOR_IS_NEEDED.consequence_if_ignored: A realism-calibrated world built from flat-shuffled geometry would have correct marginals and correct pairwise rank dependence while having NO promoter-level structure at all. The qualification would then test the estimator against a world that is realistic in its histograms and unrealistic in its hierarchy.

promoter_level.definition: one value per promoter, shared by every edge of that promoter
promoter_level.note: promoter_degree is the count of E2 edges sharing the promoter anchor, so it is definitionally a promoter property and is also the block size

derived.rule: NEVER calibrated or sampled directly. Always RECOMPUTED from the sampled base variables, so the algebraic relationships hold exactly by construction.

not_calibrated_here.reason: S45. These are produced inside frozen T.simulate from simulated donor matrices; they are not world inputs and no calibration step can reach them.

REQUIRED_INPUT_SCHEMA.source: the audited Stage-3 real feature artifact

must_carry.promoter_key: a stable identifier for the promoter anchor of each edge, sufficient to group edges into true promoter blocks BEFORE any shuffling
must_carry.edge_rows: one row per E2 edge with the 6 base features
must_carry.linked_flag: whether the row is a linked E2 edge or a matched control

REQUIRED_INPUT_SCHEMA.fail_closed: If the promoter key is absent, calibration STOPS. It does not infer blocks from feature values, and it does not proceed flat.

FROZEN_TWO_LEVEL_PROCEDURE.step_1_build_the_real_hierarchy: group real edge rows by promoter key; record the real block-size distribution, which is the real promoter-degree distribution
FROZEN_TWO_LEVEL_PROCEDURE.step_2_calibrate_the_promoter_level: estimate the joint distribution of (promoter_degree, promoter_activity) over PROMOTERS, one observation per promoter, not per edge. Weighting promoters by their edge count here would over-represent high-degree promoters and is forbidden.
FROZEN_TWO_LEVEL_PROCEDURE.step_3_calibrate_the_edge_level_CONDITIO: estimate the distribution of the 4 edge-level variables CONDITIONAL on the promoter-level draw. The conditioning variable is promoter_degree, binned by its own empirical quantiles, so that edges are drawn from promoters of comparable degree.
step_4_generate: draw a synthetic promoter: one (degree, activity) pair from the promoter-level calibration
draw that promoter's `degree` edges from the edge-level calibration conditioned on its degree bin
recompute all 6 derived features from the sampled bases
FROZEN_TWO_LEVEL_PROCEDURE.exactness_requirement: The promoter-level marginals and the edge-level marginals must each be reproduced exactly by rank reordering within their own level, as in the Iman-Conover arm already frozen. Exactness is asserted per level and the run refuses to emit on failure.
FROZEN_TWO_LEVEL_PROCEDURE.declared_sensitivity_arm: WHOLE-PROMOTER-BLOCK BOOTSTRAP: resample entire real promoter blocks with replacement, preserving the real hierarchy exactly but unable to extrapolate. Reported alongside the primary; material disagreement between arms is a reportable finding about the conditional model, not something to resolve by preference.

REQUIRED_OUTPUT_SCHEMA.promoter_index: for each edge row, the index of its synthetic promoter, so the hierarchy is explicit in the artifact rather than implied
receipt_must_record: the sha256 of every emitted geometry NPZ, so downstream stages can bind to the receipt and not merely to caller-supplied digests
real vs synthetic promoter-level marginals and joint structure
real vs synthetic edge-level marginals conditional on degree bin

MANDATORY_HIERARCHY_REALISM_CHECKS.note: Marginal agreement is not evidence of hierarchical agreement. These are additional to the existing realism receipt, not a replacement.
checks: block-size distribution: real vs synthetic promoter degree, including the degree-1 mass and the observed maximum
within-promoter variance of each edge-level variable, real vs synthetic
intraclass correlation of each edge-level variable by promoter, real vs synthetic -- this is the direct measure of whether hierarchy survived
number of distinct promoters generated versus the real count
MANDATORY_HIERARCHY_REALISM_CHECKS.claim_rule: No world may be described as preserving NIH-CARD promoter structure without the intraclass-correlation comparison.

POST_CONSTRUCTION_REQUIREMENT.rule: Realism must be verified on the features the ESTIMATOR ACTUALLY SEES, recomputed from the constructed world, not only on the calibration input.
POST_CONSTRUCTION_REQUIREMENT.reason: the derived features are rebuilt from the world and the depth sensitivities are regenerated inside the simulator, so input-side realism does not imply world-side realism

WHAT_THIS_CONTRACT_DOES_NOT_CLAIM: it does not calibrate depth-sensitivity geometry (S45, open)
it does not calibrate donor count, per-donor metacell count, sparsity, missingness or edge-specific donor support (S46, open)
it does not change the estimator, the nuisance families, M_MIN or any threshold
it does not make the historical 14-D span diagnostic interpretable; that verdict remains withdrawn
